node.statement: With Y=(Y_i) and V=(V_i), rectangular matrix multiplication gives Y^dagger dot V = sum_i Y_i^dagger dot V_i. Node 1.3.1 gives Y_i^dagger dot V_i=<Y_i,V_i>*u_Q for each i. Therefore Y^dagger dot V=sum_i(<Y_i,V_i>*u_Q)=(sum_i<Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q=<Y,V>_n*u_Q, where the penultimate equality is finite distributivity of scalar multiplication and the last is exactly the defining coordinate formula in the preceding child. Suppressing the amplification subscript yields the assertion of nodes 1.3.2 and 1.3.
